en.t: He also ordered that the messenger be rewarded.

units.source_text: 二女公子正当青春盛年，姿色十分姣美。

en.t: The Second Princess was in the full bloom of youth, and her beauty was exceptionally lovely.

units.source_text: 近来身经种种忧患，玉容稍稍瘦削，然而非常娇艳，

en.t: Having lately endured many sorrows, her fair face had grown a little thin, yet she was still remarkably delicate and radiant,

units.source_text: 反而更增秀丽，相貌酷肖已故的大女公子。

en.t: and this only added to her grace; in appearance she closely resembled the late Elder Princess.

units.source_text: 两人并存之时，只见各有其美，并不觉得肖似。

en.t: When the two had been alive together, people saw only each one's distinct beauty and did not feel that they looked alike.

units.source_text: 但现在看来非常相像，骤然一见，竟令人忘记了大女公子已死，

en.t: But now she seemed very much like her, and at a sudden glance one could almost forget that the Elder Princess had died,
and believe that this was truly she.

units.source_text: 众侍女看看这二女公子，想道：“中纳言大人日夜思念大小姐，

en.t: The waiting women looked at the Second Princess and thought, "Lord Middle Counselor longs for the elder young lady day and night,

units.source_text: 竟想保留她的遗骸，以便常常得见。

en.t: and even wished to keep her remains so that he might often see her.

units.source_text: 既然如此，当初何不娶了二小姐，难道是没有宿缘的么？”

en.t: If that is so, why did he not marry the second young lady in the first place? Could it be that they had no bond from a former life?"
They all felt it was a great pity.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言邸内常有人来宇治，故彼此情况随时传闻。

en.t: People from Kaoru the Middle Counselor's residence often came to Uji, so news of each side was constantly passed back and forth.

units.source_text: 据说薰中纳言由于悲伤过度，竟致神思恍惚，

en.t: It was said that Kaoru the Middle Counselor was so overcome with grief that his mind had grown dazed and distracted,

units.source_text: 不顾新年佳节，两眼常是红肿。

en.t: and even during the festive New Year season his eyes were always red and swollen.

units.source_text: 二女公子闻之，想见此人对姐姐的爱情确非浅薄，

en.t: When the Second Princess heard this, she understood that his love for her elder sister had truly not been shallow,

units.source_text: 此时对他的同情就更深了。

en.t: and at that moment her sympathy for him grew still deeper.
